item.description:
Osler 1.1.1 fixes updates and ships the fixes that were waiting on them.

  • Updates install properly now.
  • A stuck or crashed MCP server can't hang a run or take Osler down, and the canvas tells you when one didn't start.
  • An answer stopped by Max tokens is marked “Cut off” instead of looking finished.
  • New nodes use the provider you have set up, and double-click no longer deletes a node unless you turn that on.

After this update macOS may ask once whether Osler can use the keys in your Keychain. Click Always Allow.
